added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own two arms (baseline_suite importers-base.log at e8c804a98: 8 failed/411 passed; after_suite importers-head.log at a21ac3bd2: 8 failed/411 passed). The arm failure sets differ by one id each: this id is head-only and tests/test_follower_freshness.py::test_failed_reexec_reports_once_and_keeps_the_registration is base-only. The manifest attributes this id as a parallel-run flake under retry_failures and the five-alone logs bear that out (five-alone.log red in 1 of 5 runs at head, five-alone-base.log red at base too), so the change adds no failure in substance; the raw arm delta is recorded here as the one id, not as a zero, because that is what the two gate logs support.

3.reason: the merge population measures the head-only id with five isolated runs at base and candidate, so its attribution rests on that measurement rather than the worker's retry record

findings.text: own = watch_lock_path(project).with_suffix(".events") re-derives the events-file path that reckon/crew/run_paths.py:31 already owns as watch_stream_path, and WATCH_EVENTS_SUFFIX at :2067 restates the ".events" literal, so the same path now has two spellings that can drift.

the project-C clause asserts the total stays 8 rather than 13 so that C's older entry of 5 is not read, but C's producer is never published (only A and B at :120-121), so _other_project_producer_is_live excludes C whatever _newest_session_event returns; the assertion cannot redden on a regression in the newest-transition selection it names, though that selection is guarded through B's 0 transition at :176-178.

the changed-test gate log's first line names only the command, not the revision and tree a gate log is required to carry, so its 1-passed result cannot be fixed to a commit; every other log in the run names its revision.

the manifest's tests line records '0 added failures' while its own baseline_suite and after_suite arms differ by one failure id (test_a_crashed_producer_is_restarted.py::test_deliberate_stop_is_not_restarted[supervisor-term]), so the zero rests on the flake attribution recorded in retry_failures rather than on the arm delta the field is derived from.
